thought.text: The integration tests already validate the CLI's core path. One final end-to-end check: serve the sample catalog locally and run the exact documented command.

reasoning_content:
The integration tests are already executing `check_dcat_catalog` against the local server, and they're passing. For a true end-to-end CLI run, I'll do the following:

1. Serve tests/data/ on a local port
2. Run `poetry run python dcat_catalog_check.py --url http://localhost:8000/catalog.ttl > results.jsonl`
3. Check results.jsonl

I'll run it in the background with a timeout (since it checks many distributions with format verification, it might take a bit of time, but the tests ran in about 2 seconds, so it should be fast).

action.command:
cd /workspace/tests/data && nohup python3 -m http.server 8123 > /tmp/http_server.log 2>&1 &
echo "server $!"; sleep 2; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:8123/catalog.ttl
